# Research Experience

- **Integrated Photonics.** Design and experimental demonstration of photonic circuits, with theoretical work toward all-optical neural networks.
- **Disordered Photonics.** Development of hypergraph models of wave scattering for scalable design of disordered photonic materials.
- **Topological Photonics.** Investigation of non-Abelian topology for robust and programmable control of light.
